// Connect handlers for browser clients (replaces grpc-web).
	logStacktraces := s.Profile.Demo
	connectInterceptors := connect.WithInterceptors(
		NewMetadataInterceptor(), // Convert HTTP headers to gRPC metadata first
		NewLoggingInterceptor(logStacktraces),
		NewRecoveryInterceptor(logStacktraces),
		NewAuthInterceptor(authorizer),
	)
	connectMux := http.NewServeMux()
	connectHandler := NewConnectServiceHandler(s)
	connectHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers(connectMux, connectInterceptors, connect.WithReadMaxBytes(maxAPIRequestBytes))

	connectGroup := echoServer.Group("")
	connectGroup.Any("/memos.api.v1.*", echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(connectMux, maxAPIRequestBytes)))

	return nil
}

content.text:
q19.

**Connect RPC (`/memos.api.v1.MemoService/*`)** — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40` registers it via `wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...))` inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`, and the per-method Connect wrappers that adapt the gRPC implementation live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:304` onward (the `// MemoService` section: `CreateMemo`, `ListMemos`, `GetMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, …). The mux is mounted at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:139-144`.

**REST / HTTP-JSON via grpc-gateway (`/api/v1/...`)** — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108`, `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)`, registered on the gateway mux created at `v1.go:96` and served at `v1.go:126-129`.

Note both are served from the same in-process implementation (`APIV1Service`, which embeds `v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer` at `v1.go:26`) — there is no `grpc.NewServer` / `RegisterMemoServiceServer` call anywhere in the repo, so no native gRPC listener; the gateway is registered in `HandlerServer` (in-process) mode.
